The software inventory overview endpoint allows you to view the current information about your or...
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zdx/v1/inventory/software

The software inventory overview endpoint allows you to view the current information about your organization's software distribution across all your users. The endpoint gets the list of all softwares, the number of users using a specific model and the vendor of the software.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
loc
integer[]

The Zscaler location (ID). You can add multiple location IDs.

dept
integer[]

The department (ID). You can add multiple department IDs.

geo
string[]

The active geolocation (ID). You can add multiple active geolocation IDs.

userids
integer[]

The user IDs.

deviceids
integer[]

The device IDs.

Responses
​
200
401
403

Software Inventory List

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
